title: build(deps): bump three 0.186.1 -> 0.187.0 and @types/three 0.186.0 -> 0.187.0 in /packages/client
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. three is a production dependency (r186 -> r187); @types/three is its matching type package and moves in lockstep. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid.
behavior_change: Production rendering library moves r186 -> r187; measured no visible change in the one live consumer. three is shipped: it is bundled into the DxfToGcodeView chunk (REVISION '187' found in dist/assets/DxfToGcodeView-*.js) via main.ts -> router -> DxfToGcodeView -> ToolpathPlayer -> ToolpathCanvas3D.vue. r187's API removals are CubeUVReflectionMapping (with the cube_uv_reflection shader chunk; PMREM envmaps now flagged by texture.isPMREMTexture) and the r177-deprecated ColorManagement.fromWorkingColorSpace/toWorkingColorSpace aliases; the client uses none of them, nor any envMap, PMREM, render target, setViewport/setScissor or ArrayCamera. ToolpathCanvas3D uses Scene, PerspectiveCamera, WebGLRenderer (antialias, setSize, setPixelRatio), Ambient/DirectionalLight, MeshPhong/MeshBasic/LineBasic/LineDashed/SpriteMaterial, Line, Mesh, Sprite, CanvasTexture, GridHelper, Raycaster and OrbitControls. Source diff of those paths: WebGLRenderer viewport now uses getTargetPixelRatio(), which returns the same _pixelRatio when no render target is set; ColorManagement._getMatrix multiplication order fixed (identity for sRGB/linear-sRGB, which share primaries); Color CSS parser accepts decimal percentages; MeshPhongMaterial change is a doc comment only (displacementScale was already 1); Line.copy and Sprite.toJSON gain fields. OrbitControls (examples/jsm) changes are bug fixes: dolly used clientX for both axes (now clientY), zoomToCursor during drag, state reset when rotate/pan are disabled; key listeners move from getRootNode() back to ownerDocument. Rendered A/B of the real ToolpathCanvas3D (fixed 57-segment fixture: rapids, 3 depth passes of cuts and cw/ccw arcs, stock, grid, tool at 50% progress; headless Chromium/SwiftShader, 800x600, DPR 1): r186 vs r187 = 0 differing pixels of 480,000 (66,899 non-background). Controls: r186 re-run = 0 (deterministic); r186 tool diameter 6 -> 6.5 mm = 2,683 differing pixels (the method detects a 0.5 mm change). A first attempt that reported 0 was discarded: a stale dev server was still serving r187 for both sides, caught because the harness reports THREE.REVISION. Not covered by the A/B: interactive OrbitControls behaviour (the dolly-axis fix above is a behaviour change, in the corrective direction), the heatmap/measurement modes, and real GPUs. three@0.187.0 emits a THREE_CJS_DEPRECATED warning on require('three'); nothing in the repo requires it (Vite resolves the ESM build), and the package export map is identical between versions. @types/three 0.187.0: types only; vue-tsc stays at 87. Lockfile enumerated against merge base f7b8a6aa: exactly two versions move (three, @types/three); both packages' dependencies and peerDependencies are unchanged and equal the registry's. Dependabot flipped `peer` on 16 unchanged-version entries (npm-version churn); dropped per main's convention since ec88eedd. Branch merged with origin/main 111f401b (after #474 eslint-plugin-vue) and the lockfile rebuilt as main's lockfile + the three/@types/three root ranges and package entries.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares three ^0.187.0 (was ^0.186.1) and @types/three ^0.187.0 (was ^0.186.0). packages/client/package-lock.json resolves three 0.187.0 and @types/three 0.187.0 (root dependency/devDependency ranges + the two package entries: version, resolved, integrity). No other lockfile entry differs from origin/main 111f401b.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. The bump is open as PR #475 and both CBSP21 gates fail there for want of a manifest of its own; this is that manifest.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No source file. No three.js call site. Neither @types/three's six dependencies nor three's (none) change, so no transitive package moves. vue-tsc ceiling (87) and lint ceilings (34 / 6979) unchanged. eslint-plugin-vue 10.12.0 (#474), vue 3.5.45 (#473) and axios 1.21.0 (#470) are all as on main. Lockfile `peer` flags stay as on main.
